OD.message: This eye could focus on the light 0.99 m away, which makes it read more myopic than it is (here −0.50 D) by an amount this capture cannot show. It is no more myopic than −0.93 D; whether it is emmetropic, mildly myopic or hyperopic needs an eye examination.
notes: Allows for the eyes focusing on the light 0.99 m away, which makes an eye read more myopic than it is: by up to 13.1 D at this age, at 0–100% of what the eye needs.
Drift in focusing of ±0.35 D (SD) included for this age group.
CYL/AXIS quantification is disabled until validated on controlled multi-meridian data.

report.interpretation: SIMULATED DATA. No refractive error this method can measure at this distance. An eye that can focus on the light hides hyperopia and mild myopia from it.
report.disclaimer: Experimental research prototype. This is a screening estimate, not an eyeglass prescription, and it does not replace a comprehensive eye examination. Abnormal red reflexes can indicate conditions unrelated to refractive error. Sudden vision loss, eye pain, flashes, floaters or trauma require urgent professional assessment.
